author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಚಿಂತೆಯಿರುವವಗೆಂದು ಚಿತೆಪಡೆವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಯು
ಚಿಂತನೆಯೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರುವ ದಾರಿ
ಮಂಥಿಸುತ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಉತ್ತರವ ಹುಡುಕುತಿರೆ
ಕಂತೆ ಚಿಂತೆಯ ಕಳೆವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: One who carries worry may find his funeral pyre;
reflection is the way out of it;
if you churn things over and keep looking for answers,
you will shed your bundle of worries, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The Kannada plays on chinte (worry), chite (funeral pyre) and chintane (reflection). Worry consumes us like a pyre; clear thinking is the way out, and seeking answers dissolves the worry.
